briefdescription.para: Compute the cooperative chunk budget (us) for task_idx in sched.

detaileddescription.para: Returns the smallest sched->max_wait_ms[prio] * 1000 among all participating peer tasks j != task_idx (any non-SUSPENDED peer that is currently alive or executed at least one profiled step in mgr). Returns UINT32_MAX when uncontended or out of range.

parameterdescription.para: Optional profiler manager (used to include completed peers).
Optional output receiving the constraining peer priority (0xFF if none).

simplesect.para: Allowed cooperative chunk duration in microseconds, or UINT32_MAX if unbounded.

briefdescription.para: Verify profiled cooperative chunk durations against scheduler peer budgets.

detaileddescription.para: Scans all profiled tasks with step_count > 0 up to min(mgr->count, sched->task_count), counting every task whose max_yield_us exceeds syn_task_profile_task_budget_us(). Populates worst_out (when non-NULL) with the violation having the largest overrun (max_yield_us - budget_us).

parameterdescription.para: Scheduler instance whose tasks were profiled.
Output receiving total number of budget-violating tasks.
Optional output receiving the worst violation (zeroed if 0).
